definition: [ נֵ֫בֶךְ ] noun [masculine] spring (si vera lectio) (√ unknown); — only plural construct נִבְכֵייָֿם Job 38:16 the springs, sources of the ocean (|| חֵ֫קֶר תְּהוֺם ); — Ol Siegf נִבְלֵי ; Bu suggests נבעי = מֵבֻּעֵי as possibly; but Gr Perles read נִבְכֵי Job 28:11 , also, for Masora מִבְּכִי , compare נָהָר 2.
